cards.title: Format a typed score
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Interpolation is human-facing and uses current culture; MachineScore is the invariant wire variant. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Use a nullable value safely
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Null selects a default; explicit zero remains zero. See OptionalQuantity for domain rejection. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Sum only even numbers
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Inclusive positive limit; zero or negative limits do no work. SentinelSum teaches rejection separately. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Clamp a value with a method
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Inclusive bounds; reversed bounds are rejected before Math.Clamp. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Encapsulate a visit counter
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. A new counter begins at zero; this minimal counter is single-threaded. BalanceAccount adds validation. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Describe different objects through a contract
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. IDescribe is a synchronous caller-supplied contract; DescriptionBoundary adds null/empty rejection. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Copy an order record with a changed quantity
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Uses the companion OrderExample record; with is shallow and AddOne does not itself validate or check overflow. OrderCopy validates a replacement quantity. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Select the first value with a generic method
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Enumerates once and throws for empty input; disposes the foreach enumerator. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Count repeated words in a dictionary
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Whitespace-separated words use ordinal case-sensitive identity; blank input yields an empty dictionary. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Classify a value with pattern matching
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Null, positive int and nonempty string are recognized; zero/negative/other objects use the fallback. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Group and total orders with LINQ
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Uses OrderExample; ordinal name grouping and sorting produce a snapshot. Caller supplies valid rows, or uses ValidTotals. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Report an invalid positive quantity
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Positive integer parsing uses current culture; ImportQuantity demonstrates invariant input and wrapped failures. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Cancel asynchronous work cooperatively
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Cooperative cancellation passes to Task.Delay; checked doubling can overflow. No wall-clock timing guarantee is assumed. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Dispose a reader after reading a line
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Owns its StreamReader; missing file throws while an empty file returns null. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Close an asynchronous resource on failure
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. LeaseExample records async cleanup; UseAsync deliberately throws after work so cleanup can be inspected. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Write and read a UTF-8 report
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Writes then reads the caller-owned temporary path using framework UTF-8 defaults; caller removes it. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Deserialize and validate a JSON order
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Uses OrderExample with web JSON options; malformed JSON and invalid/null domain data fail separately. Unknown fields are accepted here; StrictProduct rejects them. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Fetch a response with cancellation and status checks
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Caller reuses HttpClient. This method owns and disposes the response even when status checks throw. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Serve a local minimal JSON API
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Register EndpointExample.Map on the caller-owned app; GET /health returns status JSON. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Validate an order before returning Created
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Uses OrderExample and registers POST /orders. Domain errors return field validation problems; malformed/null body is binding rejection. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Return a stable public API error
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Registers a stable 503 problem; private implementation details are deliberately absent. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Test minimal API requests in process
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Place in Tests with Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing 10.0.13 and the supplied public Program entry point; TestServer hosts the exact API cards. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Test a single behavior with xUnit
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Place in Tests with xUnit 2.9.3; depends on ClampExample and asserts the exact reversed-bound failure. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Test clamp boundaries with a theory
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Place in Tests with xUnit 2.9.3; five rows assert ClampExample inclusive boundaries. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Await cancellation assertions in xUnit
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Place in Tests with xUnit 2.9.3; depends on AsyncExample and awaits caller-cancellation rejection. Implicit framework imports are enabled in the pinned playground; tooling is separate.

cards.title: Guard a divisor before evaluating a ratio
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Integer division intentionally truncates. A zero denominator skips division.

cards.title: Reject unknown flag bits before authorizing
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. An explicit mask rejects unsupported permissions; flags can combine.

cards.title: Reject an overflowing row count
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. A nonnegative count must fit a signed 32-bit destination.

cards.title: Parse and round an invariant invoice amount
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. No grouping, exponent or currency symbols; round half to even explicitly.

cards.title: Match a protocol command without culture dependence
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Only a complete trimmed token matches; substrings do not.

cards.title: Write a fixed invariant report line
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Interpolation uses invariant formatting and forbids multiline labels; not a CSV serializer.

cards.title: Move a value point without changing its source
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. A readonly record struct supplies equality; checked movement rejects overflow.

cards.title: Parse only defined delivery modes
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. TryParse alone accepts undefined numeric enum values; validate separately.

cards.title: Normalize an explicit-offset timestamp to UTC
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Accepts second precision and an explicit numeric offset, never local-zone guessing.

cards.title: Count exclusive calendar-day intervals
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Calendar days use an exclusive end; no time-zone or 24-hour duration assumption.

cards.title: Serialize a tag list through a type alias
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. The alias resolves a type, not a package install; default JSON serializer escapes strings.

cards.title: Compute a bounded distance with a static import
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Promote before subtraction so overflow is detected at the explicit narrowing boundary.

cards.title: Sum a variable number of checked quantities
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Two overloads demonstrate static argument types; params accepts zero or many values.

cards.title: Update a counter only after successful parsing
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. A failed parse leaves the counter intact; out still has a value and overflow throws.

cards.title: Validate an init-only product before using it
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Callers must initialize Name; Label separately checks domain rules.

cards.title: Keep a fixed score board nonnegative
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. The array enforces the index range; setters reject negative scores before mutation.

cards.title: Find an entity through an interface constraint
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. class permits null from SingleOrDefault; duplicate keys remain an explicit failure.

cards.title: Apply a polymorphic shipping policy
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. An abstract base prevents direct construction; the concrete override owns validation.

cards.title: Create independent running-total closures
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Each factory call owns separate captured storage; this closure is not thread-safe.

cards.title: Unsubscribe an event handler even when work fails
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. The caller owns the feed; subscription lifetime is limited by finally.

cards.title: Deduplicate tags with ordinal case folding
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Returns a sorted snapshot; input is not modified.

cards.title: Contrast a live readonly view with an isolated snapshot
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. The view follows later list mutation; the snapshot is a separate mutable array.

cards.title: Keep customers without matching orders
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. LINQ-to-Objects left join; right duplicates produce multiple rows; unmatched right rows are ignored.

cards.title: Flatten batches and sort ties deterministically
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Materialization avoids validating and then re-enumerating a lazy source.

cards.title: Materialize a filtered report once
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. A snapshot prevents later source mutation from changing report rows.

cards.title: Represent an empty average as absence
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Nullable Average returns null for empty input; negative durations are rejected.

cards.title: Recover only a missing report file
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Injected read operation keeps file lifetime with the caller; only missing input is optional.

cards.title: Preserve an exception while recording cleanup
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Cleanup must be nonthrowing to preserve a work failure; there is no catch/rethrow stack reset.

cards.title: Reject malformed UTF-8 bytes in a stream
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Caller owns the input stream; BOM autodetection is disabled and invalid bytes throw.

cards.title: Copy file bytes asynchronously with caller cancellation
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. CreateNew protects an existing destination; a failed copy may leave a partial file owned by the caller.

cards.title: Observe every task failure after a batch completes
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. A pure-cancellation group is rethrown; faulted groups return all flattened failures.

cards.title: Transform a batch with a fixed concurrency ceiling
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Index-addressed output preserves input order while Parallel limits active operations.

cards.title: Translate only a local deadline into a timeout
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Use with HttpClient timeout disabled to let this deadline own timeout classification; caller cancellation takes precedence.

cards.title: Cancel and observe the loser in a two-task race
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Both delegates must return tasks without synchronous throwing and cooperate with cancellation; cleanup is awaited.

cards.title: Stream rows and stop on caller cancellation
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. No buffering beyond the supplied array; cancellation is checked before each yield.

cards.title: Complete a bounded channel after producing rows
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. A single producer and consumer preserve order; completion propagates transform failures. Use the same cancellation token for both.

cards.title: Reject missing, null and unknown JSON product fields
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Required field presence and domain validity are checked separately; web casing accepts name.

cards.title: Read a string-only JSON enum contract
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. The built-in converter accepts case-insensitive names but rejects numbers with this option.

cards.title: Validate an HTTP JSON order and dispose its response
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Caller reuses the client; response ownership stays inside Read on every outcome.

cards.title: Stream an HTTP body with a strict byte limit
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. A counted loop bounds payload memory and disposes stream/response on rejection.

cards.title: Return a stable error for invalid item identifiers
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Register Map in Program. int route constraints distinguish an unknown route from invalid domain input.

cards.title: Bind an optional report limit and validate its range
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Absent query uses ten; malformed numbers fail binding; domain values have field errors.

cards.title: Resolve a fresh session per scope
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Caller disposes provider and scopes; root resolution of scoped services is rejected.

cards.title: Register a named HTTP client through its factory
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Factory pools handlers; this task configures clients without issuing network requests.

cards.title: Validate a report limit from configuration
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. This caller resolves options immediately; a hosted application validates on startup.

cards.title: Validate independent named export profiles
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Named options avoid sharing unrelated profiles; monitor can observe reloads in a real host.

cards.title: Reject a blank route name with an endpoint filter
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. The filter applies only to this route; encoded whitespace exercises rejection through TestServer.

cards.title: Log a request outcome and add a stable response header
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Register before routes. Structured fields omit query/body secrets; finally logs rejected requests too.

cards.title: Define a customer inventory with relational constraints
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Place in the library with pinned EF SQLite. Version is application-managed; SQLite has no SQL Server rowversion.

cards.title: Insert an aggregate through its navigation property
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Uses CatalogDb from the schema card; database constraints reject nonpositive quantity.

cards.title: Return an ordered untracked inventory projection
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Projection yields strings so entities are not tracked; SQLite ordering uses its selected collation.

cards.title: Bind a hostile name as a SQL parameter
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. FromSql takes FormattableString; do not assign the interpolation to string first.

cards.title: Roll back both inserts when a later save violates uniqueness
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. A duplicate second name must roll back the first save too; rollback ignores the cancelled caller token.

cards.title: Recover from a failed relational save
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. For a user-facing result distinguish provider error codes in production; this example reports only accepted/rejected.

cards.title: Reject a stale tracked inventory edit
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Caller loads a tracked item; the original Version participates in the UPDATE predicate.

cards.title: Retry one stale increment after reloading
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. At most two saves; recompute after refresh. Deleted rows and repeated contention surface to the caller.

cards.title: Own an isolated temporary directory through async lifecycle
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. The explicit lifecycle test verifies teardown; implement IClassFixture in consumers that need shared setup.

cards.title: Use a class fixture and data-driven immutable cases
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. A stateless class fixture is safely shared; MemberData creates fresh rows and stable decimal expectations.

cards.title: Format a score using an explicit machine culture
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. An explicit separator and invariant integer formatting define a machine-readable line.

cards.title: Distinguish an absent quantity from an invalid quantity
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Only absence selects the default; explicit zero is rejected.

cards.title: Stop at a sentinel and reject invalid rows
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Zero ends input; later values are deliberately ignored; negatives before the sentinel fail.

cards.title: Validate an inclusive range before invoking a callback
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. A callback expresses variable work; validation runs before invoking it.

cards.title: Encapsulate an account balance invariant
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Private setters keep all balance changes behind validation.

cards.title: Validate an interface boundary without choosing an implementation
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Uses the legacy IDescribe contract; callers can supply independent implementations.

cards.title: Return a validated order copy with a checked quantity
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Record equality is value-based, while with performs a shallow copy; this record holds only string and int.

cards.title: Enforce exactly one generic selection
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Disposes lazy enumeration; absence and ambiguity have different failures.

cards.title: Add a unique case-insensitive inventory key
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Dictionary.Add rejects duplicate logical keys; zero inventory is valid.

cards.title: Match order shape and reject invalid states
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. A property pattern distinguishes absence, single/bulk and invalid input.

cards.title: Validate rows before a grouped aggregate snapshot
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. One input enumeration, domain validation and deterministic grouping reuse the legacy aggregation.

cards.title: Wrap a parse failure without losing its cause
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Only format errors are wrapped; overflow/domain failures keep their own type.

cards.title: Await work while preserving checked arithmetic failures
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Cooperative checks run before each addition; empty input completes with zero.

cards.title: Dispose a caller-transferred reader after parsing fails
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Unlike leaveOpen stream tasks, this method explicitly takes ownership of the supplied reader.

cards.title: Dispose an async lease on success and cancellation
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Uses the legacy lease; ownership is transferred and cleanup runs on both exits.

cards.title: Distinguish a missing optional report from an empty report
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Only FileNotFoundException means absence; permissions and invalid directories surface.

cards.title: Validate each order in a JSON report array
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. JSON null, null elements and invalid domain fields are distinct from an empty array.

cards.title: Apply an owned deadline to a reused HTTP client
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Reuses HttpExample response disposal; set client.Timeout to InfiniteTimeSpan so the explicit deadline owns timeout classification.

cards.title: Propagate a request token into report work
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Minimal API binds CancellationToken to RequestAborted; direct cancellation tests exercise the same exact work method.

cards.title: Validate an empty or partially invalid request batch
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Null array body is rejected by binding; a null element fails explicit validation.

cards.title: Map a known failure to a stable problem response
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. A known I/O failure becomes a public stable code; private exception details are omitted.

cards.title: Assert request rejection and recovery through the real host
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Uses Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing 10.0.13 and the exact registered route card, without external sockets.

cards.title: Assert state remains usable after a rejected mutation
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. An exception assertion is paired with state and recovery assertions, not just the thrown type.

cards.title: Exercise valid and invalid parsing rows with MemberData
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. MemberData supports computed or nonattribute-compatible data; use isolated, deterministic rows.

cards.title: Await overflow and cancellation assertions before recovery
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Await every assertion so failures belong to this test rather than an abandoned task.

cards.title: Use a global alias inside an explicit namespace
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. The global directive must precede namespaces at compilation-unit level; it affects only this compilation. Ordinary namespace imports appear in the alias/static tasks.

cards.title: Pass a readonly point by reference
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Uses the readonly record struct GridPoint; in prevents assigning to the parameter and avoids a mutable struct copy.

cards.title: Compose a raw interpolated diagnostic template
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. Two dollar signs reserve double braces for interpolation; single braces and backslashes remain literal. This diagnostic is not JSON escaping.

cards.title: Rename a wire field while keeping a C# member name
cards.explanation: C# 14 / net10.0. JsonPropertyName controls the external field; constructor binding still uses the CLR member name. Presence and domain validation remain separate.
